verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships a first-party Playground, an interactive browser code editor at playground.babylonjs.com, which implies a quick edit-and-run preview loop for scripts. The evidence never explicitly describes instant re-run behavior or hot reload, and nothing covers fast iteration in a local project setup. missing for 10: explicit documentation of instant preview/re-run on script change, hot module reload for local projects, independent or hands-on corroboration of edit-run loop speed.
